overview.title: Overview
overview.description: How many kits you can pack, what is missing and what changed.

restock.heading: Needs restocking
restock.emptyDescription: Items show up here once they reach their reorder level.

recent.heading: Recent activity
recent.emptyDescription: Stock changes show up here as you make them.

welcome.title: Add your first item
welcome.description: Start tracking stock by adding the things you keep on hand.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.description: Add an item to start tracking how much of it you have.

noMatches.title: No items match
noMatches.description: Try a different search or clear the filters.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, location or tag

form.name: Name
form.reorderLevelDescription: The item counts as low stock at or below this quantity.
form.moduleUsageDescription: How many of this item go into one feeder, device and sorting module. Leave at 0 if it is not a kit part.
form.unitCostDescription: Unit cost is the lot price divided by the units per lot.
form.unitCostDerived: Unit cost: {{unitCost}} (lot price divided by units per lot).
form.tagsDescription: Use tags for where you buy this part. Press Enter or comma to add one.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The item is removed from your inventory. Its past stock changes stay in the activity log.

bulk.adjustDescription_one: Applies to the {{count}} selected item, which has {{lowest}} in stock.
bulk.adjustDescription_other: Applies the same change to each of the {{count}} selected items. The lowest stock among them is {{lowest}}.

tags.title: Edit tags
tags.description_one: Change the tags on the {{count}} selected item.
tags.description_other: Change the tags on all {{count}} selected items.

delete.description: The items are removed from your inventory. Their past stock changes stay in the activity log.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: The latest {{count}} stock changes, newest first.

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.description: Every stock change is recorded here.

capacity.heading: What you can pack now
capacity.description: Each number assumes all your stock goes to that one thing.

setup.title: Set up your kit parts
setup.description: Edit an item and fill in how many go into each feeder, device and sorting module. Kit stats appear once at least one item is a kit part.

planner.heading: Plan kits
planner.description: A kit is 1 feeder module, 1 device module and 3 or 5 sorting modules.
planner.empty: Enter how many kits you need to see what you have and what is missing.
planner.tableCaption: Parts needed for the planned kits

remove.title: Remove from inventory
remove.description: Takes the parts for whole kits or single modules out of stock and records it in the activity log.
remove.noParts: No items are set up as parts of this yet.
remove.notEnough: You do not have enough parts for this.

print.title: Print labels
print.descriptionOne: A label for {{name}} with a QR code you can scan to change its stock.
print.descriptionMany_one: A label for the {{count}} item shown, with a QR code you can scan to change its stock.
print.descriptionMany_other: Labels for the {{count}} items shown, each with a QR code you can scan to change its stock.
print.labelsAlreadyUsedDescription: For a sheet you have started: how many labels are already peeled off, counting left to right, top to bottom. Printing starts on the next one.
print.sheetHint: For 3/4 × 2 1/4 inch return address labels, 30 per Letter sheet (Avery 6870 layout). Print at 100% or Actual size, not Fit to page.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Scan an item label to change its stock.

status.permissionDenied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then reload.
status.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
status.insecureContext: The camera only works over HTTPS. Open the app from its https:// address.
status.failed: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it, then reload.

feedback.notItemLabel: That code is not one of your item labels.
feedback.unknownItem: That label belongs to an item that is no longer in your inventory.

howTo.heading: How it works
howTo.print: Print labels from the Items page and stick them on your bins or shelves.
howTo.point: Point the camera at a label so the QR code sits inside the frame.
howTo.adjust: Add or remove stock in the dialog that opens, then scan the next one.
